title: supply-chain-release-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: make check MODULES=pkg/identity/reference; exact inputs: module_set, dependency_lockfiles, artifact_digests, provenance_records; initial state: release candidate contains all affected modules and immutable dependency inputs

stimulus.const: Run make check MODULES=pkg/identity/reference for success, failure cases using module_set, dependency_lockfiles, artifact_digests, provenance_records and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: vulnerability, secret, license, SBOM, provenance, and clean-consumer gates pass and every release artifact digest is bound; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal; required artifact fields: module_count, artifact_count, sbom_digest, provenance_digest, release_report_digest, protocol_case_results

actual_outcome.const: Invariant: vulnerability, secret, license, SBOM, provenance, and clean-consumer gates pass and every release artifact digest is bound; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal; required artifact fields: module_count, artifact_count, sbom_digest, provenance_digest, release_report_digest, protocol_case_results

x-cross-field-rules: every observations[].artifact_sha256 value must equal one artifact_hashes[].sha256 value
